purpose: Schema PRIOR for the dynamic-application runtime. Hints only. Fresh rendered DOM is authoritative. Nothing here is a selector contract or a script. Read-only observation: no submit, no typing, no upload, no account.

coverage.note: Both employers mapped (Padel39 x2 postings, Keep Aware). Rails form; clean <label for> bindings.

observed_samples.classification_note: 7 employer questions incl. single-choice relocation radio; cover letter optional
No employer questions; cover letter REQUIRED

page_shape.form: form#job-applicant-form method=post action=/postings/<slug>/applicants; sections 'Profile', 'Contact Information', 'Application Details', 'Applicant details', 'Employer Questions'; submit input[type=submit][name=commit] value 'Submit your application'. OneTrust cookie preference center present (Privacy Preference Center headings).

control_families.text: input[type=text|email] name job_applicant[<field>] id job_applicant_<field>; <label for> text; '(optional)' suffix on optional labels; required via native required attr.
control_families.file: input[type=file]#job_applicant_resume (required) and #job_applicant_cover_letter (optional or required per employer); no accept attr; label text 'Upload your resume PDF, up to 10MB'; dropzone copy 'Click or drag over to replace the file'.
control_families.custom_text: input[type=text] name job_applicant[custom_form_response_attributes][answers_attributes][<i>][text]; question label is a preceding <label> (not for-linked) — hidden inputs [<i>][question_uuid] and [<i>][question_type]=text accompany it.
control_families.custom_single_choice: hidden [<i>][question_type]=single_choice + <label for=…_<i>_selected_option_uuids> question text + radios name …[<i>][selected_option_uuids][] value=<option uuid> wrapped in <label> with <span> option text; required attr on radios.

field_patterns.label_seen: Upload your cover letter (optional) PDF, up to 10MB | Upload your cover letter PDF, up to 10MB
Upload your resume PDF, up to 10MB

examples_seen: How many years of relevant experience do you have? [text]
What is the earliest date you are available to start this position? [text]
Which ad platforms have you personally run campaigns in, and for how many years? [text]
What is the largest monthly ad budget you have personally managed? [text]
Which analytics or attribution tools have you set up and used yourself? [text]

Are you currently based in Austin? If not, how soon would you be relocating? [single_choice: 'Yes, based in Austin' | 'Actively moving, 1 month' | 'Plan to move, 2-3 months' | 'Need to move, 3+ months']
What excites you about joining the Padel39 family? [text — narrative in a single-line input]

blockers.detail: Resume always required; cover letter required on some employers

runtime_observations: Narrative questions are single-line text inputs (no maxlength attr) — long answers still fit but render on one line.
Single-choice radios carry multiple=multiple attr oddly; treat as radio by type.
Question text for custom fields is the nearest preceding <label> without for= (text) or with for=…_selected_option_uuids (choice).

provider_hint.for_jev: Gusto: single page. First/Last/Email required, middle name and phone optional, 'Additional information' textarea optional, Resume PDF required (10MB), cover letter PDF optional or required, then employer questions as required short-text (years of experience, start date, platforms, budget, tools, motivation narrative) and single-choice radios (relocation). No captcha/login. Stop at 'Submit your application'.

edge_cases.detail: Keep Aware marks cover letter file required
